summary: Fixed spring platforms barely bouncing, crumbling platforms remaining solid after falling, and the HUD height counter freezing above 9 m.

bugs.title: Spring platforms launch with JUMP * 0.4 instead of SPRING velocity
bugs.evidence: In land(pl), landing on a spring sets p.vy = JUMP * 0.4 (5.0, ~0.39 m bounce) instead of the defined SPRING constant (22), making the 4.5-6 m gap after a spring impossible to clear.

bugs.title: Crumbling platforms stay solid in mid-air after falling away
bugs.evidence: In updatePlatforms(dt), when pl.crumbleT > 0.55 sets pl.falling = true and drops pl.g.position.y, pl.active remains true and pl.y is unchanged, so the player keeps standing on invisible collision.

bugs.title: HUD height counter stops updating at 10 m and above
bugs.evidence: In updateHud(zone), hHeight.textContent is only updated when h < 10 (if (h !== shownH && h < 10)), freezing the displayed altitude at 9 m.

bugs.title: Not a bug: Player missed the second platform jump at 0:34
bugs.evidence: At 0:15-0:33 the player landed on the first platform at 1 m, and at 0:34 missed the next platform and fell to game over at 0:38.

edits.find: if (h !== shownH && h < 10) { shownH = h; hHeight.textContent = h; }
edits.replace: if (h !== shownH) { shownH = h; hHeight.textContent = h; }
edits.why: Fix: allow the HUD height counter to update past 9 meters.

edits.find: if (pl.crumbleT > 0.55) { pl.falling = true; sfx.crack(); burst(pl.x, pl.y, pl.z, 10, 0.8); }
edits.replace: if (pl.crumbleT > 0.55) { pl.falling = true; pl.active = false; sfx.crack(); burst(pl.x, pl.y, pl.z, 10, 0.8); }
edits.why: Fix: deactivate crumbling platforms when they start falling so the player does not remain standing in mid-air.

edits.find:
if (pl.type === "spring") {
        p.vy = JUMP * 0.4; p.springing = true; p.sq = 0.55;
edits.replace:
if (pl.type === "spring") {
        p.vy = SPRING; p.springing = true; p.sq = 0.55;
edits.why: Fix: use the SPRING launch velocity instead of JUMP * 0.4 when landing on a spring pad.

summary: Fixed player character facing backwards relative to movement direction, and fixed a null-reference crash when collecting a gem.

bugs.title: Player character faces backwards when moving
bugs.evidence: At 0:07-0:12, the player's eyes and cheeks are on the +Z local face of the body mesh, but `Math.atan2(-p.vx, -p.vz)` rotates the +Z local face toward `(-vx, -vz)`, causing the character to face the exact opposite direction of travel (at 0:13 after moving right/back, the face is turned away).

bugs.title: Collecting a gem throws a TypeError crash
bugs.evidence: In `updatePlayer`, when a gem is collected, `pl.gem = null` is executed and the very next line logs `height: pl.gem.position.y`, which throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'position')`.

bugs.title: Not a bug: Walked off the edge of platform 46 when jumping toward platform 47
bugs.evidence: At 0:16-0:17, the player jumped while holding D without W/S adjustment and missed the next platform, falling to game over at 0:22.

edits.why: Fix: The player's eyes and cheeks are positioned at +Z (+0.41), so rotation.y must be atan2(vx, vz) so the character faces the direction of movement instead of backwards.

edits.find:
pl.g.remove(pl.gem); pl.gem = null; gems++;
          logEvent("gem", { platform: pl.id, total: gems, height: pl.gem.position.y });
edits.replace:
pl.g.remove(pl.gem); pl.gem = null; gems++;
          logEvent("gem", { platform: pl.id, total: gems, height: +gy.toFixed(2) });
edits.why: Fix: Avoid reading `pl.gem.position.y` after setting `pl.gem = null`, which throws a TypeError whenever a gem is collected.
